extra.reason: Fixed by making attachment base64 encoding fallible, propagating attachment read errors through provider builders, and adding regression tests for missing/unreadable lazy attachments.
Confirmed provider attachment paths load lazy data or propagate attachment errors; added SMTP lazy attachment unit coverage and Resend HTTP adapter lazy payload coverage.

Default delivery telemetry no longer records recipient addresses, subjects, or message ids at INFO/ERROR. Spans and outcome events now expose provider, recipient/attachment counts, status, and duration, with regression coverage for deliver and deliver_with.

Accepted the v0.7 target API decision: EmailClient is the primary instance-owned API, globals remain compatibility sugar, provider dispatch uses static clients plus explicit boxed adapters, provider config/options become typed, and migration constraints are documented in docs/decisions/0001-v0-7-public-api.md.

MailError now preserves source chains for serde_json, reqwest, askama, lettre, SMTP transport, lettre address, and attachment IO errors; Clone was removed; error kind/status helpers were added; regression tests cover source chains and provider classification.

Added the generic EmailClient primary API with default sender preparation, single and batch delivery, telemetry/metrics parity, Arc/reference mailer adapters, tests, and docs/examples leading with EmailClient while preserving global helpers as compatibility facades.

Added explicit typed MailerConfig/provider config structs, testable from_env_with helpers, EmailClient::from_env(), documented auto-detection order, and moved global compatibility setup onto the explicit config path. Primary EmailClient::new delivery remains env-free.

Added ResendEmailExt typed helpers for tags, scheduled_at, idempotency key, and template payloads; documented provider_option as an advanced raw escape hatch; exported typed Resend option API; and covered typed option serialization with provider tests.

Added PreparedEmail as the validated delivery boundary, routed Mailer direct/client/facade paths through provider-aware preparation, migrated adapters to deliver_prepared/deliver_many_prepared, preserved SendGrid custom personalization validation, and added regression tests for direct mailer and facade validation.

Made Email, Address, and Attachment fields crate-private, added read-only accessor APIs, updated integration tests and doctests to use accessors, preserved serde derives/field names, and documented field-access migration notes for v0.7.
Implemented shared immutable attachment byte storage with clone-sharing tests and documented ownership semantics.

Added feature-gated Tokio-backed lazy attachment reads for async providers, migrated provider serialization paths to await attachment I/O, documented the feature gate, and covered async/lazy sends with tests.

Removed the process-global LocalMailer storage singleton, made env local mailers create ordinary isolated LocalMailer instances, left local_storage as a deprecated non-creating compatibility facade, updated preview docs to pass storage explicitly, and added isolation/regression tests.

Standardized provider address serialization with RFC 5322 quoting for mailbox-string APIs and IDNA/Punycode domains across structured providers, added SMTP/Gmail custom header support with invalid-name errors, documented behavior, and added provider/header regression tests.

Recorded Decision 0002: keep async_trait as the v0.7 object-safe Mailer trait, make EmailClient<M> the primary API, keep Arc<dyn Mailer> as explicit runtime dispatch, and defer a native-async/static-plus-boxed split until benchmarks justify the migration.
Fixed stale Missive dependency versions and aligned documented feature bundles with Cargo.toml.
